module: Utility functions shared by the freeform delivery submodules: vehicle position cache, site object lookup (locations, zones, parking spots), tests for a vehicle's presence in a target area, path resolution, time formatting and player access (vehicle or on foot).
notes: The position cache is never invalidated automatically: getCachedVehiclePosition only recomputes if the entry does not exist; updateVehicleCache / updateVehicleCacheList must be called regularly to refresh it.
The vec3 returned by getCachedVehiclePosition is the cache's vec3: do not modify it.
checkParking is called with a tolerance of 0.8 (fixed value in the code).
findSiteObject searches first by name (byName) then by numeric index (objects[tonumber(siteId)]); sites must contain locations, zones and parkingSpots.

updateVehicleCache.desc: Updates a vehicle's cached position (without allocation) and marks it valid.

updateVehicleCacheList.desc: Updates the cache for each vehicle of a list.

getCachedVehiclePosition.desc: Returns a vehicle's cached position (computes it on the first call).

returns.desc: Shared position, do not modify; nil if veh is invalid.

formatTime.desc: Formats a duration in seconds as H:MM:SS (if at least one hour) or M:SS.

findSiteObject.desc: Finds a site object (location, zone or parking spot) by type and identifier.

sites.desc: Sites table with locations, zones, parkingSpots (each with byName and objects).

siteId.desc: Name or index of the object.

getVehicleIds.desc: Normalizes a goal: returns goal.vehicleIds, or {goal.vehicleId}, or an empty array.

checkVehicleInParkingSpot.desc: Tests whether a vehicle is parked in a spot via parkingSpot:checkParking(vehId, 0.8).

returns.desc: Result of checkParking, false if an argument is missing.

checkVehicleInArea.desc: Unified presence test: location (distance <= radius), zone (containsVehicle) or parking spot.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle is in the area.

resolvePath.desc: Resolves a relative path against the folder of a base file. A path starting with '/' is returned as is.

returns.desc: Resolved path, nil if relativePath is nil or folder not found.

findTargetArea.desc: Finds a target area by id in delivery.targetAreas.

findVehicle.desc: Finds a vehicle's definition by id in delivery.vehicles.

getVehicleObjectByDeliveryId.desc: Converts a delivery vehicle ID into a vehicle object (via gameplay_freeformDelivery_setup.getVehicleId then Sim.upcast).

getVehiclePositionByDeliveryId.desc: Cached position of the vehicle designated by its delivery ID.

getPlayerPosition.desc: Player position: cached position of their vehicle, otherwise the position of the character if walking (gameplay_walk).

getParkingInfo.desc: Details a vehicle's parking in a spot: number of corners in the spot (0 to 4), validity and spot size.

returns.desc: {valid, cornerCount, corners, spotSize={x,y,z}}; nil if no corner is in the spot.
